title: EU ENISA Vulnerability Database (EUVD) — KEV, CVSS & NIS2 Feed Input

modes.title: Query modes
modes.description: Select EUVD feeds/modes: exploited (latest KEV), critical (latest critical CVSS), latest, search (filtered query), or lookup_by_id.

text.title: Keyword search (for search mode)
text.description: Search across description, EUVD ID, CVE alias, vendor, and product.

fromScore.title: Minimum CVSS score (0-10, optional)
fromScore.description: Minimum CVSS base score for search mode.

fromEpss.title: Minimum EPSS score (0-100, optional)
fromEpss.description: Minimum EPSS score for search mode.

exploited.title: Exploited only (for search mode, optional)
exploited.description: Filter search mode to Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV).

ids.title: Specific CVE or EUVD IDs (for lookup_by_id mode)
ids.description: List of CVE or EUVD identifiers to look up directly (e.g. ['CVE-2024-3400']).

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of deduplicated vulnerability records to output.
